# Valerie Lam
  
Hi! I've worked at nearly every level of the project pipeline, from operations and administration to data analysis and project coordination. My work has spanned several sectors; I’m quite well-versed in coordinating communication across teams with no shared vocabulary: scientists, clinicians, clients, and data teams. 

The common thread is communication through translation: taking messy, high-volume data and repackaging it into clear documentation, structured data, and processes external clients can actually use and understand. I'm looking to bring that mix of scientific rigor, cross-functional communication, and operational execution to a wider audience. 

In my spare time, you can find me trying new sports, exploring different coffee shop ambiances, or spending time with my pets.

:::

Please feel free to contact me [here](mailto:valerielam@berkeley.edu).
